sc1.title: 超導電路與非諧性~Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity
sc1.mechanism: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。~Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels.
sc1.verify: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。~Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
sc1.misconception: 所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。~Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

sc2.title: 耦合圖與路由~Coupling graphs and routing
sc2.mechanism: 原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。~Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure.
sc2.verify: 對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。~Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth.
sc2.misconception: 物理位元數相同就代表相同電路成本。~Equal physical-qubit counts imply equal circuit costs.

sc3.title: 微波控制與串擾~Microwave control and crosstalk
sc3.mechanism: 控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。~Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error.
sc3.verify: 比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。~Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices.
sc3.misconception: 單獨量到的閘精度可直接代表同時操作精度。~Isolated gate fidelity directly equals simultaneous-operation fidelity.

sc4.title: 色散讀出與指派誤差~Dispersive readout and assignment error
sc4.mechanism: 讀出將位元狀態映射到共振器響應；混淆矩陣與相干誤差是不同證據。~Readout maps states to resonator response; a confusion matrix differs from coherent-error evidence.
sc4.verify: 由標籤資料重算讀出混淆矩陣並保留樣本數。~Recalculate a labeled readout confusion matrix with sample counts.
sc4.misconception: 讀出錯誤與閘錯誤是可互換的單一指標。~Readout and gate errors are interchangeable metrics.

sc5.title: 低溫熱路與訊號負載~Cryogenic heat paths and signal loads
sc5.mechanism: 每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。~Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage.
sc5.verify: 建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。~Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage.
sc5.misconception: 室溫機櫃功耗等於稀釋冷凍機最低溫熱負載。~Room-temperature rack power equals the coldest-stage thermal load.

sc6.title: 錯誤更正與邏輯證據~Error correction and logical evidence
sc6.mechanism: 邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。~Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions.
sc6.verify: 比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。~Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances.
sc6.misconception: 增加物理位元必然降低邏輯錯誤。~More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.

ion1.title: 離子陷阱與模態~Ion traps and modes
ion1.mechanism: 電場侷限帶電離子；集體運動模態提供部分糾纏閘的中介。~Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates.
ion1.verify: 區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。~Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise.
ion1.misconception: 離子內部態與運動模態是同一個變數。~Internal states and motional modes are the same variable.

ion2.title: 雷射位址與空間串擾~Laser addressing and spatial crosstalk
ion2.mechanism: 光束位址將控制侷限到目標離子，但光學旁瓣及漂移可影響鄰近離子。~Beam addressing localizes control, but sidelobes and drift can affect neighbors.
ion2.verify: 用位址矩陣比較目標響應與非目標響應。~Compare intended and unintended responses in an addressing matrix.
ion2.misconception: 可軟體選址表示沒有光學串擾。~Software addressing implies zero optical crosstalk.

ion3.title: 運動介導的糾纏~Motion-mediated entanglement
ion3.mechanism: 兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。~Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information.
ion3.verify: 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。~Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths.
ion3.misconception: 只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。~Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.

ion4.title: 連通性與排程~Connectivity and scheduling
ion4.mechanism: 邏輯全連通不保證所有閘能同時執行；光學通道與模態共享形成排程限制。~Logical all-to-all connectivity does not imply unlimited parallel gates; shared optical channels and modes constrain scheduling.
ion4.verify: 對相同閘集合比較串行及資源受限排程。~Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set.
ion4.misconception: 全連通等同零延遲及無限並行。~All-to-all connectivity means zero latency and unlimited parallelism.

ion5.title: 離子搬運與分區~Ion transport and zoning
ion5.mechanism: QCCD 以搬運及分區連接運算區；重排時間與加熱需納入總電路成本。~QCCD connects zones by transport; rearrangement time and heating contribute to circuit cost.
ion5.verify: 畫兩區搬運圖並分開閘時間、搬運及冷卻。~Draw a two-zone transport graph and separate gates, transport and cooling.
ion5.misconception: 離子搬運時間可一律略過。~Ion transport time can always be ignored.

ion6.title: 螢光讀出與重用~Fluorescence readout and reuse
ion6.mechanism: 讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。~Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement.
ion6.verify: 比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。~Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window.
ion6.misconception: 較多光子必然改善整個電路且沒有反作用。~More photons always improve the full circuit without back-action.

neutral1.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載~Optical-tweezer arrays and loading
neutral1.mechanism: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。~Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry.
neutral1.verify: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。~Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.
neutral1.misconception: 名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。~Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.

neutral2.title: Rydberg 阻塞與距離~Rydberg blockade and distance
neutral2.mechanism: Rydberg 相互作用對原子距離敏感；常見模型以 C6/r6 描述兩體位移。~Rydberg interactions depend strongly on distance; common models use C6/r6 for pair shifts.
neutral2.verify: 在固定 C6 的假想模型比較 1.0 與 1.1 倍距離。~Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6.
neutral2.misconception: 原子距離改變隻影響圖像，不影響哈密頓量。~Atom spacing changes only the picture, not the Hamiltonian.

neutral3.title: 類比哈密頓量~Analog Hamiltonians
neutral3.mechanism: 驅動、失諧與幾何共同定義時間相依模型；類比演化不等於任意數位閘電路。~Drive, detuning and geometry define a time-dependent model; analog evolution is not an arbitrary digital circuit.
neutral3.verify: 用小系統矩陣重算本徵值與控制參數變化。~Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change.
neutral3.misconception: 類比退火可自動代表所有數位量子演算法。~Analog annealing automatically represents every digital algorithm.

neutral4.title: 脈衝與硬體限制~Pulse and hardware constraints
neutral4.mechanism: 控制序列受通道、時間與位址能力限制；模擬器允許的序列未必可上硬體。~Channels, timing and addressing bound sequences; emulator-valid controls may not be hardware-valid.
neutral4.verify: 將一段假想序列逐欄核對公開裝置約束。~Check an assumed sequence field-by-field against public device constraints.
neutral4.misconception: 模擬成功就代表能直接送往任何 QPU。~Emulator success implies execution on every QPU.

neutral5.title: 原子損失與量測~Atom loss and measurement
neutral5.mechanism: 原子缺失可能來自裝載、演化或讀出；需避免把所有缺失都當激發態。~Loss can arise during loading, evolution or readout; not every missing atom signifies excitation.
neutral5.verify: 分開實驗前後佔位與讀出混淆表。~Separate pre/post occupancy from readout confusion tables.
neutral5.misconception: 每個消失原子都唯一證明量子激發。~Every missing atom uniquely proves quantum excitation.

neutral6.title: 關聯函數與有限樣本~Correlators and finite samples
neutral6.mechanism: 關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。~Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter.
neutral6.verify: 比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。~Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples.
neutral6.misconception: 單一樣本足以證明多體相。~One shot establishes a many-body phase.

photon1.title: 光子編碼與模式~Photonic encoding and modes
photon1.mechanism: 路徑、時間箱或連續變數編碼使用不同可測自由度；模式數不是通用位元數。~Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts.
photon1.verify: 畫編碼、模式及量測的對照表。~Map encodings, modes and measurements.
photon1.misconception: 所有光子模式都可無條件計為容錯邏輯位元。~Every optical mode counts unconditionally as a fault-tolerant logical qubit.

photon2.title: 單光子源與多工~Photon sources and multiplexing
photon2.mechanism: 機率性光源可用多工增加供應率，但損耗、延遲及開關成本仍存在。~Multiplexing improves probabilistic supply, with remaining loss, delay and switching costs.
photon2.verify: 由假想獨立光源機率計算至少一個成功率。~Compute at-least-one success from assumed independent sources.
photon2.misconception: 多工同時使光源確定且沒有損耗。~Multiplexing makes sources deterministic without loss.

photon3.title: 光路損耗與可用率~Optical loss and availability
photon3.mechanism: 串接光學元件的透過率相乘；插入損耗會降低偵測及糾纏資源供應。~Cascaded transmission multiplies; insertion loss reduces detection and entangled-resource supply.
photon3.verify: 把逐段 dB 損耗轉成線性成功率後交叉核對。~Convert segment dB losses to linear success and cross-check.
photon3.misconception: 10% 的每段損耗可以直接從100%相減任意次。~Repeated ten-percent losses can be subtracted linearly from 100%.

photon4.title: 量測式與融合架構~Measurement-based and fusion architectures
photon4.mechanism: 資源態、量測及經典回饋共同實現運算；融合量測與核融合無關。~Resource states, measurements and classical feedforward implement computation; fusion measurements are unrelated to nuclear fusion.
photon4.verify: 標出量子光路與經典解碼的兩種邊。~Label quantum-optical and classical-decoder edges separately.
photon4.misconception: 光子融合閘就是核融合反應。~A photonic fusion gate is a nuclear fusion reaction.

photon5.title: 偵測器與時間解析~Detectors and timing
photon5.mechanism: 偵測效率、暗計數及時間抖動影響事件辨識；室溫光路不表示所有偵測器室溫運作。~Efficiency, dark counts and jitter affect events; ambient optics do not imply every detector runs at ambient temperature.
photon5.verify: 比較符合窗改變時的真實與偶然符合假想率。~Compare assumed true/accidental coincidences as the window changes.
photon5.misconception: 光子架構中的所有元件必然不需低溫。~All photonic-architecture components necessarily need no cryogenics.

photon6.title: 模組網路與解碼期限~Modular networks and decoding deadlines
photon6.mechanism: 跨模組糾纏需光學連接與同步；經典解碼完成時限影響可行回饋。~Intermodule entanglement needs optical links and synchronization; decoder deadlines constrain feedforward.
photon6.verify: 建立光飛行、偵測、解碼及控制的時延預算。~Budget propagation, detection, decoding and control latency.
photon6.misconception: 模組可相連就已證明大規模容錯。~Connected modules alone establish large-scale fault tolerance.

spin1.title: 量子點與自旋子空間~Quantum dots and spin subspaces
spin1.mechanism: 閘定義侷限與電荷狀態；電子自旋提供與電荷位置不同的位元自由度。~Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position.
spin1.verify: 分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。~Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels.
spin1.misconception: 能看到量子點就已證明自旋閘與讀出。~Observing a quantum dot proves spin gates and readout.

spin2.title: 交換相互作用~Exchange interactions
spin2.mechanism: 鄰近電子的波函數重疊調節交換；電荷雜訊可能映射為閘誤差。~Wavefunction overlap controls exchange; charge noise can become gate error.
spin2.verify: 對假想 J 參數做靈敏度與噪聲傳播。~Propagate assumed J sensitivity and noise.
spin2.misconception: 縮小點間距一定改善所有誤差。~Reducing dot spacing improves every error source.

spin3.title: 自旋控制與共振~Spin control and resonance
spin3.mechanism: 能階分裂設定共振尺度；控制選擇性仍受漂移與鄰近頻率限制。~Splitting defines resonance scales; drift and neighboring frequencies limit selectivity.
spin3.verify: 比較兩個假想頻率分佈的可分辨性。~Compare resolvability of two assumed frequency distributions.
spin3.misconception: 相同半導體材料代表完全相同共振頻率。~Identical semiconductor material means identical resonance frequency.

spin4.title: 自旋轉電荷讀出~Spin-to-charge readout
spin4.mechanism: 某些讀出先把自旋資訊轉成可感測的電荷事件，需分開轉換與感測錯誤。~Some readout maps spin information to charge events, requiring separate conversion and sensing error budgets.
spin4.verify: 建立兩層混淆模型並與單層近似比較。~Compare a two-layer confusion model with a one-layer approximation.
spin4.misconception: 電荷感測精度單獨等於自旋讀出精度。~Charge-sensing accuracy alone equals spin-readout accuracy.

spin5.title: 晶圓變異與可擴充性~Wafer variability and scaling
spin5.mechanism: 製程相容性支援多顆元件，但均勻性、接線及校正依然限制擴充。~Process compatibility supports many devices while uniformity, wiring and calibration still limit scaling.
spin5.verify: 比較跨假想元件參數分佈而非只取最佳點。~Compare assumed device distributions rather than one best point.
spin5.misconception: CMOS 相容即表示所有位元均已容錯。~CMOS compatibility means all qubits are already fault-tolerant.

spin6.title: 低溫電子與能耗~Cryogenic electronics and energy
spin6.mechanism: 近端電子降低接線需求但增加局部發熱；需要按低溫層分配功耗。~Local electronics reduce wiring but add heat, requiring temperature-stage power budgets.
spin6.verify: 把控制功耗與每層散熱裕度分開。~Separate controller power from cooling margins per stage.
spin6.misconception: 把控制器移到低溫可忽略其發熱。~Moving controllers cold eliminates their heat.

anneal1.title: Ising 與 QUBO 對映~Ising and QUBO mapping
anneal1.mechanism: 二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。~Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling.
anneal1.verify: 窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。~Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima.
anneal1.misconception: 任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。~Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.

anneal2.title: 稀疏耦合與嵌入~Sparse connectivity and embedding
anneal2.mechanism: 邏輯圖可透過鏈嵌入物理圖；更高連通通常減少部分鏈成本而非消除全部代價。~Chains embed logical graphs into hardware; higher connectivity can reduce some chain costs, not eliminate them.
anneal2.verify: 比較同一小圖在兩種拓撲的鏈數與長度。~Compare chain counts/lengths for one graph on two topologies.
anneal2.misconception: 物理位元數等於可直接處理的任意邏輯變數數。~Physical qubit count equals directly solvable arbitrary logical variables.

anneal3.title: 能量尺度與雜訊~Energy scales and noise
anneal3.mechanism: 參數縮放改變目標能量差相對噪聲；動態範圍會限制精細成本差。~Scaling changes cost gaps relative to noise; dynamic range limits fine objective differences.
anneal3.verify: 比較相同最優解在兩種縮放下的假想噪聲容差。~Compare assumed noise margins under two scales with unchanged exact minima.
anneal3.misconception: 縮放到任意小數值都不影響有噪聲硬體。~Arbitrary downscaling has no effect on noisy hardware.

anneal4.title: 退火過程與樣本~Annealing and sampling
anneal4.mechanism: 輸出是多次樣本的分佈；一次低成本解不證明每次或任何題目都最優。~Outputs form a sample distribution; one low-cost solution proves neither universal nor per-run optimality.
anneal4.verify: 保存全部成本分佈與最優命中率。~Retain the full energy distribution and optimum-hit rate.
anneal4.misconception: 得到一次低成本結果就證明通用加速。~One low-cost result proves general acceleration.

anneal5.title: 鏈斷裂與後處理~Broken chains and postprocessing
anneal5.mechanism: 鏈斷裂會改變解的解讀；後處理改善需與原始採樣成本一起報告。~Broken chains affect decoding; postprocessing gains need reporting alongside raw sampling costs.
anneal5.verify: 將原始樣本、解碼規則與最終目標分開比較。~Compare raw samples, decoding rules and final objectives separately.
anneal5.misconception: 後處理產生的解可全部歸因於 QPU。~Every postprocessed result is attributable solely to the QPU.

anneal6.title: 端到端比較~End-to-end comparison
anneal6.mechanism: 讀寫、嵌入及經典工作都構成使用成本；退火器並非通用閘模型電腦。~Programming, embedding and classical work add cost; annealers are not general gate-model computers.
anneal6.verify: 同條件比較完整時間、解品質與經典基線。~Compare full elapsed time, solution quality and classical baselines fairly.
anneal6.misconception: QPU 採樣時間等於完整服務時間。~QPU sampling time equals full service time.

topo1.title: 近接材料與能隙~Proximity materials and gaps
topo1.mechanism: 半導體與超導體的近接結構可能產生不同低能態；材料設計本身不是拓撲證據。~Proximity heterostructures can host different low-energy states; material design alone is not topological evidence.
topo1.verify: 列出拓撲與平庸模型都能解釋的觀測。~List observations compatible with both topological and trivial models.
topo1.misconception: 使用特定材料就已證明 Majorana 零模。~A particular material proves Majorana zero modes.

topo2.title: 奇偶量測架構~Parity-measurement architecture
topo2.mechanism: 奇偶資訊與單個電荷事件不同；干涉及電容量測需明確指定可觀測量。~Parity differs from individual charge events; interferometric/capacitance readout must specify observables.
topo2.verify: 畫裝置—訊號—推論三層證據圖。~Draw device, signal and inference as separate evidence layers.
topo2.misconception: 奇偶量測單獨證明所有拓撲運算。~Parity measurement alone proves every topological operation.

topo3.title: 信噪比與指派~SNR and assignment
topo3.mechanism: 讀出指派錯誤取決於分佈重疊與時間窗；信噪比不是邏輯位元精度。~Assignment error depends on distribution overlap/window; SNR is not logical-qubit fidelity.
topo3.verify: 用假想分佈重算信噪比及錯誤率。~Recompute SNR and error for assumed distributions.
topo3.misconception: 一次高信噪比代表容錯閘已完成。~One high-SNR readout establishes fault-tolerant gates.

topo4.title: 平庸態的競爭假說~Competing trivial-state hypotheses
topo4.mechanism: 替代機制也可能產生低能訊號；區分它們需要多個獨立觀測與模型。~Alternative mechanisms can produce low-energy signals; discrimination needs independent observables and models.
topo4.verify: 為至少兩個假說挑選預測不同的量測。~Choose measurements with different predictions for two hypotheses.
topo4.misconception: 來源標題中的產品名稱可以取代物理證據。~A product name in a headline replaces physical evidence.

topo5.title: 保護與操作證據~Protection and operation evidence
topo5.mechanism: 聲稱受保護位元需證明編碼、操作與噪聲響應；裝置量測與完整邏輯運算不同。~A protected-qubit claim needs encoding, operations and noise response; a device measurement differs from full logical computation.
topo5.verify: 分開已公開演示、作者推論與未證實能力。~Separate public demonstrations, inferred claims and unverified capabilities.
topo5.misconception: 可縮放路線圖就是實現百萬容錯位元的證明。~A scaling roadmap proves a million fault-tolerant qubits.

topo6.title: 研究重現與版本~Research reproducibility and revisions
topo6.mechanism: 原始論文的適用範圍可能小於公司路線圖；應保存版本、數據與推論限制。~A paper may support narrower claims than a roadmap; retain versions, data and inference limitations.
topo6.verify: 並排比較論文摘要與商業宣稱所需新增證據。~Compare paper-supported claims with evidence still required for commercial claims.
topo6.misconception: 論文與產品宣稱的適用範圍必然相同。~A paper and product announcement necessarily support identical scope.

nn1.title: 張量與模型計算圖~Tensors and computational graphs
nn1.mechanism: 模型由張量形狀與可微算子組成；形狀相容不保證學到正確資訊。~Models combine tensor shapes and differentiable operators; compatible shapes do not guarantee useful learning.
nn1.verify: 逐層核對輸入輸出維度、參數數及資料流。~Check per-layer dimensions, parameter counts and data flow.
nn1.misconception: 所有維度吻合就證明模型泛化。~Matching dimensions proves generalization.

nn2.title: 歸納偏置與結構~Inductive bias and structure
nn2.mechanism: 局部連接、殘差、注意力與圖鄰域對輸入關係做不同假設。~Local connections, residuals, attention and graph neighborhoods encode different assumptions about relationships.
nn2.verify: 構造保持與破壞該結構的兩種假想輸入。~Construct assumed inputs preserving and breaking the intended structure.
nn2.misconception: 換一個模型名稱不會改變其結構假設。~A different architecture never changes structural assumptions.

nn3.title: 梯度路徑與優化~Gradient paths and optimization
nn3.mechanism: 鏈式法則將誤差反傳；跳接與正規化可改變梯度尺度而非保證收斂。~The chain rule propagates errors; skips and normalization alter gradient scales without guaranteeing convergence.
nn3.verify: 以有限差分覈對一個小參數的梯度。~Check a small-parameter gradient against finite differences.
nn3.misconception: 較深或更大的模型必定更容易優化。~Deeper or larger models are necessarily easier to optimize.

nn4.title: 運算量與記憶體~Compute and memory
nn4.mechanism: 參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。~Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute.
nn4.verify: 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。~Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately.
nn4.misconception: 只用參數數即可完整預測執行速度。~Parameter count completely predicts runtime.

nn5.title: 資料切分與洩漏~Data splits and leakage
nn5.mechanism: 訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。~Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores.
nn5.verify: 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。~Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.
nn5.misconception: 測試資料參加調參仍可當獨立測試。~Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.

nn6.title: 失效分析與泛化~Failure analysis and generalization
nn6.mechanism: 平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。~Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness.
nn6.verify: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。~Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
nn6.misconception: 高confidence就足以認定答案正確。~High confidence establishes correctness.

gpu1.title: SIMT 與執行羣~SIMT and execution groups
gpu1.mechanism: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。~GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization.
gpu1.verify: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。~Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.
gpu1.misconception: 所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。~Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.

gpu2.title: 矩陣核心與精度~Matrix cores and precision
gpu2.mechanism: 專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。~Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability.
gpu2.verify: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。~Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.
gpu2.misconception: FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。~Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.

gpu3.title: HBM 與資料重用~HBM and data reuse
gpu3.mechanism: 算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。~Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic.
gpu3.verify: 畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。~Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes.
gpu3.misconception: HBM容量與HBM頻寬是同一個規格。~HBM capacity and bandwidth are the same specification.

gpu4.title: 非同步搬運與同步~Asynchronous transfer and synchronization
gpu4.mechanism: 計算與搬運重疊需正確依賴；缺少同步可能表現更快但產生錯結果。~Overlapping compute/transfers needs dependencies; missing synchronization may run faster while producing wrong results.
gpu4.verify: 將依賴圖與時間線並排檢驗。~Check dependency graphs beside execution timelines.
gpu4.misconception: 只看執行時間即可認定非同步優化正確。~Runtime alone proves an asynchronous optimization correct.

gpu5.title: 晶片與互連層級~Chip and interconnect hierarchy
gpu5.mechanism: die、GPU、節點與機架有不同通信邊界；規格需按方向及端點界定。~Dies, GPUs, nodes and racks have different communication boundaries; rates need direction/endpoint labels.
gpu5.verify: 核對單向、雙向、每GPU及總系統的單位。~Check unidirectional/bidirectional and per-GPU/system units.
gpu5.misconception: 機架總頻寬可直接當作每線程可用頻寬。~Rack bandwidth directly equals per-thread bandwidth.

gpu6.title: 能耗與工作負載~Energy and workload
gpu6.mechanism: 利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。~Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy.
gpu6.verify: 比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。~Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality.
gpu6.misconception: 較低瞬時功率必然使整項工作耗能更少。~Lower instantaneous power guarantees lower task energy.

tpu1.title: 脈動矩陣與張量核~Systolic matrices and TensorCores
tpu1.mechanism: 資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。~Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use.
tpu1.verify: 比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。~Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches.
tpu1.misconception: 脈動陣列的峯值永遠等於每種shape實效。~Systolic peak performance equals achieved performance for every shape.

tpu2.title: 向量純量與嵌入~Vectors, scalars and embeddings
tpu2.mechanism: 矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。~Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate.
tpu2.verify: 拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。~Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets.
tpu2.misconception: 所有神經網絡算子都在矩陣單元滿速執行。~Every neural operator runs at matrix-unit peak speed.

tpu3.title: 編譯與分割~Compilation and partitioning
tpu3.mechanism: 圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。~Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic.
tpu3.verify: 比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。~Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes.
tpu3.misconception: 分片隻影響存儲，不影響通信。~Sharding affects storage only, never communication.

tpu4.title: 3D 互連與拓撲~3D interconnects and topology
tpu4.mechanism: mesh與torus具有不同的邊界連接與路徑；每chip頻寬不等於割頻寬。~Meshes/toruses differ in wraparound/routes; per-chip bandwidth differs from bisection bandwidth.
tpu4.verify: 對小型3D圖計算最大跳數及割邊。~Compute diameter and cut edges for small 3D graphs.
tpu4.misconception: mesh和torus可不區分地使用全部同一指標。~Meshes and toruses share all metrics without distinction.

tpu5.title: 集體通訊與計算重疊~Collectives and overlap
tpu5.mechanism: all-reduce同步更新或統計；通信可部分重疊但仍有尾端依賴。~All-reduce synchronizes updates/statistics; communication may overlap while retaining tail dependencies.
tpu5.verify: 比較全串行與可重疊時間線。~Compare serial and overlapping timelines.
tpu5.misconception: 只要有多芯片就可以忽略all-reduce成本。~Multiple chips make all-reduce costs negligible.

tpu6.title: Pod 與工作切片~Pods and job slices
tpu6.mechanism: Pod總規模、單工作上限與可預約slice不同；配置能力不等於所有作業均可取全Pod。~Pod size, job limits and reservable slices differ; configurations do not give every job the whole Pod.
tpu6.verify: 將公開設備規模與支持的作業slice分開記錄。~Record device scale separately from supported job slices.
tpu6.misconception: Pod總芯片數就是每個作業可直接預約的數量。~Every job can directly reserve the full Pod chip count.

wafer1.title: 晶圓網格與局部記憶~Wafer meshes and local memory
wafer1.mechanism: 晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。~Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits.
wafer1.verify: 比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。~Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes.
wafer1.misconception: 沒有傳統cache就表示記憶體無限。~No conventional cache means unlimited memory.

wafer2.title: 權重串流與分離~Weight streaming and disaggregation
wafer2.mechanism: 參數可存於獨立記憶系統並串流到計算；通信帶寬與更新一致性是關鍵邊界。~Separate memory can stream weights to compute; bandwidth and update consistency remain key.
wafer2.verify: 畫前傳、反傳及參數更新的方向。~Draw forward, backward and update directions.
wafer2.misconception: 參數與計算分離就完全不需要通信。~Disaggregating parameters removes communication.

wafer3.title: 稀疏映射與負載~Sparse mapping and load
wafer3.mechanism: 稀疏數據可減少算術，但不均勻分配可能形成局部瓶頸。~Sparsity reduces arithmetic while uneven mapping can create local bottlenecks.
wafer3.verify: 比較均勻與聚集稀疏分佈的最慢核心負載。~Compare slowest-core load for uniform/clustered sparsity.
wafer3.misconception: 零元素比例相同表示執行速度相同。~Equal zero fractions imply equal runtime.

wafer4.title: 晶圓容錯與良率~Wafer redundancy and yield
wafer4.mechanism: 大面積設計需面對缺陷；冗餘與繞路形成可用資源而非完美晶圓。~Large-area designs face defects; redundancy/rerouting create usable resources, not flawless wafers.
wafer4.verify: 在假想缺陷圖檢查重映射後的連通及容量。~Check connectivity/capacity after remapping an assumed defect map.
wafer4.misconception: 可用晶圓即表示每個物理核心都無缺陷。~A usable wafer means every physical core is defect-free.

wafer5.title: 叢集擴充與參數同步~Cluster scaling and synchronization
wafer5.mechanism: 多個系統共享參數與同步梯度，擴充效率還取決於網絡和批次。~Systems share parameters/synchronize gradients; network and batches still limit scaling.
wafer5.verify: 固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。~Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch.
wafer5.misconception: 增加系統必然線性加速所有模型。~Adding systems linearly speeds every model.

wafer6.title: 冷卻與工作能量~Cooling and job energy
wafer6.mechanism: 芯片、供電與冷卻形成不同效率層；裸芯片性能不是完整系統能效。~Chip, power delivery and cooling have separate efficiencies; chip performance is not system energy efficiency.
wafer6.verify: 把計算、通信與設施能量分別列表。~List compute, communication and facility energy separately.
wafer6.misconception: 芯片指標即可取代設施能耗量測。~A chip metric replaces facility energy measurement.

neuro1.title: 脈衝與時間編碼~Spikes and temporal encoding
neuro1.mechanism: 神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。~Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding.
neuro1.verify: 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。~Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.
neuro1.misconception: 脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。~Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.

neuro2.title: 膜電位與閾值~Membrane state and threshold
neuro2.mechanism: 神經元模型積累、泄漏及發放；離散時間近似需要說明步長。~Neuron models accumulate, leak and fire; discrete approximations need timestep labels.
neuro2.verify: 重算小型leaky積分模型與兩種步長誤差。~Recompute a leaky integrator with two timestep errors.
neuro2.misconception: 改變時間步不會影響發放時間。~Changing timestep never affects firing time.

neuro3.title: 突觸記憶與可塑性~Synaptic memory and plasticity
neuro3.mechanism: 權重及學習規則儲存在本地狀態；在線學習與推論模式有不同數據流。~Local state holds weights/rules; learning and inference have different flows.
neuro3.verify: 分開權重讀、狀態寫與學習更新事件。~Separate weight reads, state writes and learning updates.
neuro3.misconception: 神經形態推論會自動完成所有監督學習。~Neuromorphic inference automatically performs all supervised learning.

neuro4.title: 事件網路與擁塞~Event networks and congestion
neuro4.mechanism: 稀疏事件減少部分活動，但突發相關放電可能使NoC擁塞。~Sparse events reduce some activity; correlated bursts may congest the NoC.
neuro4.verify: 用平均及突發事件流比較峯值隊列。~Compare peak queues under mean/bursty event flows.
neuro4.misconception: 低平均放電率保證永不擁塞。~Low mean firing guarantees no congestion.

neuro5.title: 可程式神經元~Programmable neurons
neuro5.mechanism: 可編程模型擴展神經元行爲，但支持指令、精度與存儲仍限制模型。~Programmability expands behavior within instruction, precision and memory limits.
neuro5.verify: 將數學神經元映射至允許的基本操作。~Map a mathematical neuron to allowed primitives.
neuro5.misconception: 可編程就是無精度與容量邊界。~Programmable means no precision or capacity limits.

neuro6.title: 效率與公平比較~Efficiency and fair comparison
neuro6.mechanism: 事件驅動能耗須連同輸入編碼與結果質量比較；與密集網絡需相同任務邊界。~Event-driven energy needs encoding/result-quality context; dense-network comparison needs matching task boundaries.
neuro6.verify: 比較全流程時間、能量與準確率而非只計芯片核心。~Compare end-to-end time, energy and accuracy beyond cores.
neuro6.misconception: 事件稀疏本身就證明所有任務更省電。~Sparse events alone prove lower energy for every task.

server1.title: 節點與記憶體層級~Nodes and memory hierarchy
server1.mechanism: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。~CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access.
server1.verify: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。~Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
server1.misconception: 統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。~Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.

server2.title: 節點內與節點間網路~Intranode and internode networks
server2.mechanism: 高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。~Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer.
server2.verify: 按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。~Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth.
server2.misconception: 節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。~Intranode GPU rates equal interrack fabric rates.

server3.title: 工作分割與平行效率~Work partition and parallel efficiency
server3.mechanism: 串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。~Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time.
server3.verify: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。~Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
server3.misconception: 峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。~Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.

server4.title: 儲存階層與檢查點~Storage tiers and checkpoints
server4.mechanism: 暫存、容量與歸檔層服務不同I/O；檢查點需考慮寫入和恢復成本。~Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs.
server4.verify: 比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。~Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets.
server4.misconception: 容量大表示小檔隨機訪問一定快。~Large capacity guarantees fast random small-file access.

server5.title: 供電冷卻與設施~Power, cooling and facilities
server5.mechanism: 設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。~Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result.
server5.verify: 覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。~Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries.
server5.misconception: 低PUE保證相同任務計算能耗最低。~Low PUE guarantees minimum compute energy for a task.

server6.title: 排程隔離與復原~Scheduling, isolation and recovery
server6.mechanism: 多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。~Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery.
server6.verify: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。~Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
server6.misconception: 換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。~Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.

nuclear1.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界~Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries
nuclear1.mechanism: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。~Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries.
nuclear1.verify: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。~Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
nuclear1.misconception: 所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。~All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.

nuclear2.title: 熱循環與淨電效率~Thermal cycles and net efficiency
nuclear2.mechanism: 熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。~Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ.
nuclear2.verify: 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。~Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance.
nuclear2.misconception: 熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。~Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.

nuclear3.title: 餘熱與持續冷卻~Residual heat and sustained cooling
nuclear3.mechanism: 停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。~Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture.
nuclear3.verify: 只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。~Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only.
nuclear3.misconception: 停止發電後任何排熱需求都立即變成零。~All heat-removal demand immediately vanishes after generation stops.

nuclear4.title: 被動與主動支援~Passive and active support
nuclear4.mechanism: 重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。~Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths.
nuclear4.verify: 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。~Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison.
nuclear4.misconception: 被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。~Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.

nuclear5.title: 模組化與共用系統~Modularity and shared systems
nuclear5.mechanism: 小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。~Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies.
nuclear5.verify: 做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。~Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map.
nuclear5.misconception: 模塊數增加就自動消除所有共同故障。~More modules automatically eliminate common failures.

nuclear6.title: 建造證據與生命週期~Construction evidence and lifecycle
nuclear6.mechanism: 設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。~Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation.
nuclear6.verify: 覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。~Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete.
nuclear6.misconception: 取得設計批准等同每個電廠已商轉。~Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.

fusion1.title: 約束方式與系統邊界~Confinement and system boundaries
fusion1.mechanism: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。~Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant.
fusion1.verify: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。~Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
fusion1.misconception: 達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。~A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.

fusion2.title: 加熱與能量增益~Heating and gain
fusion2.mechanism: 等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。~Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses.
fusion2.verify: 分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。~Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power.
fusion2.misconception: Q大於1就保證全廠淨髮電大於0。~Q above one guarantees positive plant net electricity.

fusion3.title: 磁體或光學精度~Magnet or optical precision
fusion3.mechanism: 磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。~Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region.
fusion3.verify: 比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。~Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries.
fusion3.misconception: 局部誤差可由整體平均良好自動排除。~A good global average automatically excludes local error.

fusion4.title: 熱排出與表面負載~Heat exhaust and surface loads
fusion4.mechanism: 熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。~Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands.
fusion4.verify: 由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。~Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area.
fusion4.misconception: 相同總功率代表所有表面熱通量相同。~Equal total power means equal surface heat flux everywhere.

fusion5.title: 診斷與控制證據~Diagnostics and control evidence
fusion5.mechanism: 診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。~Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information.
fusion5.verify: 分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。~Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars.
fusion5.misconception: 模型輸出都可當成直接無誤差量測。~Every modeled value is an error-free direct measurement.

fusion6.title: 研究裝置與電廠差距~Research-to-power-plant gaps
fusion6.mechanism: 可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。~Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance.
fusion6.verify: 列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。~List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations.
fusion6.misconception: 單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。~One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.

wind1.title: 風資源與功率包絡~Wind resources and power envelopes
wind1.mechanism: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。~Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output.
wind1.verify: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。~Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
wind1.misconception: 額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。~Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.

wind2.title: 葉片氣動與載荷~Blade aerodynamics and loads
wind2.mechanism: 扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。~Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide.
wind2.verify: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。~Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
wind2.misconception: 提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。~More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.

wind3.title: 傳動與發電轉換~Drivetrain and electrical conversion
wind3.mechanism: 齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。~Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently.
wind3.verify: 由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。~Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies.
wind3.misconception: 直驅代表無需發電機或功率電子。~Direct drive removes generators and power electronics.

wind4.title: 支撐繫泊與動態~Supports, mooring and dynamics
wind4.mechanism: 固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。~Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion.
wind4.verify: 比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。~Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations.
wind4.misconception: 浮式風機可忽略波浪與繫泊。~Floating turbines can ignore waves and moorings.

wind5.title: 陣列尾流與海纜~Array wakes and cables
wind5.mechanism: 上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。~Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies.
wind5.verify: 分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。~Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime.
wind5.misconception: 風場效率就是單機效率與機組數相乘。~Farm efficiency is single-turbine efficiency times turbine count.

wind6.title: 監測維護與疲勞~Monitoring, maintenance and fatigue
wind6.mechanism: 海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。~Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime.
wind6.verify: 用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。~Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series.
wind6.misconception: 容量因數與可用率是同一比例。~Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

hydro1.title: 水頭流量與能量~Head, flow and energy
hydro1.mechanism: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。~Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections.
hydro1.verify: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。~Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
hydro1.misconception: 壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。~Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.

hydro2.title: 水輪機與工況~Turbines and operating envelopes
hydro2.mechanism: Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。~Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary.
hydro2.verify: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。~Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
hydro2.misconception: 所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。~All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.

hydro3.title: 水路暫態與水錘~Water transients and water hammer
hydro3.mechanism: 快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。~Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales.
hydro3.verify: 比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。~Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times.
hydro3.misconception: 穩態水頭足以排除全部暫態壓力。~Steady head excludes all transient pressure.

hydro4.title: 土建機械與滲流~Civil works, mechanics and seepage
hydro4.mechanism: 壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。~Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation.
hydro4.verify: 畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。~Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables.
hydro4.misconception: 沒有可見漏水就證明基礎與壩體完全健康。~No visible leakage proves a sound dam/foundation.

hydro5.title: 發電儲能與調度~Generation, storage and scheduling
hydro5.mechanism: 抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。~Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints.
hydro5.verify: 分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。~Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy.
hydro5.misconception: 抽回同一水就可無輸入重複製造淨能量。~Recirculating water creates unlimited net energy without input.

hydro6.title: 泥砂環境與壽命~Sediment, environment and life
hydro6.mechanism: 泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。~Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW.
hydro6.verify: 比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。~Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics.
hydro6.misconception: 高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。~High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

geo1.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量~Reservoir concepts and observables
geo1.mechanism: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。~Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
geo1.verify: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。~Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
geo1.misconception: 測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。~A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

geo2.title: 井筒完整性與熱損~Well integrity and heat loss
geo2.mechanism: 井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。~Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence.
geo2.verify: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。~Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
geo2.misconception: 井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。~A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.

geo3.title: 閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環~Flash, dry-steam and binary cycles
geo3.mechanism: 資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。~Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries.
geo3.verify: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。~Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.
geo3.misconception: 所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。~Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.

geo4.title: 換熱結垢與腐蝕~Heat transfer, scaling and corrosion
geo4.mechanism: 結垢降低熱傳且影響流阻；化學腐蝕與機械磨耗不是同一機制。~Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear.
geo4.verify: 把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。~Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence.
geo4.misconception: 輸出下降只能來自地下溫度下降。~Output decline can only mean falling subsurface temperature.

geo5.title: 回注質量與熱突破~Reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough
geo5.mechanism: 回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。~Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough.
geo5.verify: 比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。~Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories.
geo5.misconception: 回注量相同就證明熱突破時間相同。~Equal reinjection rates imply equal breakthrough time.

geo6.title: 微震監測與生態~Microseismic monitoring and environment
geo6.mechanism: 地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。~Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics.
geo6.verify: 僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。~Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only.
geo6.misconception: 單一發電指標可替代地震及環境監測。~One generation metric replaces seismic/environmental monitoring.

oil1.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡~Reservoir models and material balance
oil1.mechanism: 油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。~Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources.
oil1.verify: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。~Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.
oil1.misconception: 地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。~Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.

oil2.title: 井筒屏障與完整性~Well barriers and integrity
oil2.mechanism: 多個屏障路徑與監測共同支持完整性；概念課不提供鑽井或井控操作參數。~Multiple barriers/monitoring support integrity; conceptual courses supply no drilling or well-control settings.
oil2.verify: 用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。~Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations.
oil2.misconception: 一項井口量測足以證明所有地下屏障。~One wellhead measurement proves every subsurface barrier.

oil3.title: 多相輸送與壓降~Multiphase transport and pressure drop
oil3.mechanism: 氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。~Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions.
oil3.verify: 比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。~Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch.
oil3.misconception: 油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。~Oil/gas/water mixtures are indistinguishable from pure water without qualification.

oil4.title: 海底連接與平臺~Subsea links and platforms
oil4.mechanism: 立管、海底設備與上部處理各有壓力、運動及可維修邊界。~Risers, subsea systems and topsides have distinct pressure, motion and serviceability boundaries.
oil4.verify: 畫平臺—海底接口並標海況及維護假設。~Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions.
oil4.misconception: 平臺穩定證明海底所有部件沒有動態負載。~Platform stability proves no dynamic load on subsea components.

oil5.title: 處理能量與排放~Processing energy and emissions
oil5.mechanism: 分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。~Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero.
oil5.verify: 分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。~Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions.
oil5.misconception: 岸電必然等於整個油氣產品零排放。~Shore power means zero lifecycle emissions for oil/gas products.

oil6.title: 監測停機與復原~Monitoring, shutdown and recovery
oil6.mechanism: 可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。~Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only.
oil6.verify: 在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。~Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table.
oil6.misconception: 恢復產量本身就證明所有安全狀態均正確。~Recovered production proves every safety state correct.

mine1.title: 資源品位與代表採樣~Resources, grade and representative sampling
mine1.mechanism: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。~Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate.
mine1.verify: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。~Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
mine1.misconception: 最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。~The best sample represents every ore parcel.

mine2.title: 開坑地下與搬運~Open-pit, underground and haulage
mine2.mechanism: 露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。~Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks.
mine2.verify: 畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。~Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths.
mine2.misconception: 露天與地下可沿用所有支護和搬運參數。~Surface and underground systems share every support/haulage parameter.

mine3.title: 粒徑解離與破碎~Particle size, liberation and comminution
mine3.mechanism: 粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。~Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery.
mine3.verify: 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。~Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy.
mine3.misconception: 研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。~Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.

mine4.title: 重力選別與質量收支~Gravity separation and mass balance
mine4.mechanism: 密度、粒徑及形狀共同影響重力分離；精礦品位、產率與回收率不同。~Density, size and shape affect gravity separation; concentrate grade, yield and recovery differ.
mine4.verify: 用給定假想給料與精礦計算金屬守恆。~Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data.
mine4.misconception: 精礦品位越高就保證回收金屬越多。~Higher concentrate grade guarantees more metal recovered.

mine5.title: 通風電力與自動化~Ventilation, power and automation
mine5.mechanism: 地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。~Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation.
mine5.verify: 比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。~Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine.
mine5.misconception: 自動化設備無需人員與道路隔離設計。~Automated equipment needs no people/route separation design.

mine6.title: 尾礦水與復育~Tailings, water and rehabilitation
mine6.mechanism: 尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。~Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints.
mine6.verify: 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。~Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.
mine6.misconception: 回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。~High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

resnetspecial1.title: 殘差映射與恆等路徑~Residual maps and identity paths
resnetspecial1.mechanism: 殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。~A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition.
resnetspecial1.verify: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。~Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.
resnetspecial1.misconception: 任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。~Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.

resnetspecial2.title: 卷積感受野與解析度~Convolutional receptive field and resolution
resnetspecial2.mechanism: 堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。~Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone.
resnetspecial2.verify: 逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。~Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer.
resnetspecial2.misconception: 相同kernel尺寸保證所有層感受野相同。~Equal kernel sizes imply equal receptive fields at every layer.

resnetspecial3.title: 殘差雅可比與梯度~Residual Jacobians and gradients
resnetspecial3.mechanism: 等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。~A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction.
resnetspecial3.verify: 以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。~Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices.
resnetspecial3.misconception: 存在恆等跳接就消除全部梯度問題。~An identity skip eliminates every gradient problem.

transformerspecial1.title: 縮放點積注意力~Scaled dot-product attention
transformerspecial1.mechanism: QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。~Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs.
transformerspecial1.verify: 用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。~Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions.
transformerspecial1.misconception: 注意力權重就是所有token的固定平均。~Attention weights are a fixed average over every token.

transformerspecial2.title: 遮罩與資訊流~Masks and information flow
transformerspecial2.mechanism: 因果遮罩排除未來位置；padding遮罩處理無效token，兩者服務不同條件。~Causal masks exclude future positions; padding masks exclude invalid tokens and serve different conditions.
transformerspecial2.verify: 在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。~Draw both masks on a small score matrix and inspect visible positions.
transformerspecial2.misconception: padding遮罩可自動防止所有未來資訊洩漏。~A padding mask automatically prevents all future leakage.

transformerspecial3.title: 位置表徵與順序~Position representations and order
transformerspecial3.mechanism: 無位置資訊的自注意力對置換具有對應性；位置表徵將順序條件加入token。~Self-attention without positions is permutation-equivariant; positional representations add order conditions.
transformerspecial3.verify: 交換token後比較有無位置表徵的輸出對應。~Compare permuted outputs with/without position representations.
transformerspecial3.misconception: 純自注意力天生知道絕對token順序。~Pure self-attention inherently knows absolute token order.

unetspecial1.title: 收縮與擴張路徑~Contracting and expanding paths
unetspecial1.mechanism: encoder取得多尺度語境，decoder恢復空間輸出；上採樣不是取得新的原始影像資訊。~The encoder gathers multiscale context and the decoder restores spatial outputs; upsampling creates no new original-image information.
unetspecial1.verify: 追蹤各尺度shape與輸出像素對應，標出裁切或padding。~Trace scale shapes/output alignment and mark cropping/padding.
unetspecial1.misconception: 上採樣必然恢復所有已失去的細節。~Upsampling necessarily restores all lost detail.

unetspecial2.title: 跨尺度跳接與對齊~Cross-scale skips and alignment
unetspecial2.mechanism: U-Net跳接常串接encoder與decoder特徵；空間shape及座標需對齊，與ResNet加法不同。~U-Net skips often concatenate encoder/decoder features; spatial shapes/coordinates must align, unlike residual addition.
unetspecial2.verify: 比較concat與add的channel數及空間對齊。~Compare channels/alignment for concatenation versus addition.
unetspecial2.misconception: 串接與殘差相加永遠是同一運算。~Concatenation and residual addition are always identical.

unetspecial3.title: 像素損失與物件尺度~Pixel loss and object scale
unetspecial3.mechanism: 像素類別不平衡會掩蓋小物件；重建輪廓與全影像平均準確率是不同任務。~Class imbalance can hide small objects; boundary reconstruction differs from mean pixel accuracy.
unetspecial3.verify: 手算同一小mask的混淆表、交集及分區誤差。~Compute confusion, overlap and regional errors for one small mask.
unetspecial3.misconception: 背景像素多時高準確率即保證小目標分割。~High accuracy dominated by background guarantees small-target segmentation.

gatspecial1.title: 圖鄰域遮罩~Graph-neighborhood masks
gatspecial1.mechanism: GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。~GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph.
gatspecial1.verify: 用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。~List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph.
gatspecial1.misconception: 每個GAT節點都必然能看見所有節點。~Every GAT node necessarily sees every other node.

gatspecial2.title: 非對稱邊權與聚合~Asymmetric weights and aggregation
gatspecial2.mechanism: 注意力aij可與aji不同，即使基礎鄰接圖無向；聚合仍需保留目標節點與來源。~Attention aij may differ from aji even on undirected adjacency; aggregation retains target/source roles.
gatspecial2.verify: 用假想特徵手算兩方向權重並檢查節點更新。~Calculate assumed bidirectional weights and check node updates.
gatspecial2.misconception: 無向鄰接圖強制所有注意力權重對稱。~Undirected adjacency forces symmetric attention weights.

gatspecial3.title: 歸納式與轉導式證據~Inductive and transductive evidence
gatspecial3.mechanism: 跨未見圖泛化與同圖未標籤節點预测不同；圖建構本身也可能洩漏標籤。~Unseen-graph generalization differs from unlabeled-node prediction on one graph; graph construction itself can leak labels.
gatspecial3.verify: 分開兩種測試邊界並審查建邊資訊來源。~Separate both test boundaries and audit edge-construction information.
gatspecial3.misconception: 同圖高分已足夠證明未見圖泛化。~High scores on one graph establish unseen-graph generalization.

moespecial1.title: 閘控與稀疏專家~Gating and sparse experts
moespecial1.mechanism: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。~Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ.
moespecial1.verify: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。~List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.
moespecial1.misconception: 所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。~Every model parameter activates on every token.

moespecial2.title: 容量與路由負載~Capacity and routing load
moespecial2.mechanism: 專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。~Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow.
moespecial2.verify: 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。~Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow.
moespecial2.misconception: 平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。~Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.

moespecial3.title: 專家資料搬運~Expert data movement
moespecial3.mechanism: 分散專家需搬運token與輸出；all-to-all通信會影響端到端成本及負載平衡。~Distributed experts move tokens/results; all-to-all traffic affects cost/load balance.
moespecial3.verify: 固定token數比較本地與跨裝置專家路由bytes。~Compare local/cross-device routing bytes at fixed token count.
moespecial3.misconception: 稀疏啟動表示完全沒有裝置間通信。~Sparse activation removes all interdevice communication.

autospecial1.title: 全連接層與參數~Dense layers and parameters
autospecial1.mechanism: 單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。~For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification.
autospecial1.verify: 對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。~Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP.
autospecial1.misconception: 一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。~Layer parameters always equal neuron count.

autospecial2.title: 線性瓶頸與非線性~Linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities
autospecial2.mechanism: 線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。~A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives.
autospecial2.verify: 用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。~Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples.
autospecial2.misconception: 增加非線性必然重建所有輸入且無損失。~Nonlinearity necessarily reconstructs every input losslessly.

autospecial3.title: 重建與任務效用~Reconstruction and task utility
autospecial3.mechanism: 低重建誤差可能保留背景而忽略小但關鍵訊號；latent表徵需用獨立任務驗證。~Low reconstruction error may preserve background but omit small critical signals; validate latents on independent tasks.
autospecial3.verify: 構造相同平均重建誤差但不同關鍵訊號保留的兩案例。~Construct equal-mean-error cases with different critical-signal preservation.
autospecial3.misconception: 重建誤差低就證明所有下游任務最佳。~Low reconstruction error proves optimality for every downstream task.

lstmspecial1.title: 記憶與三個閘~Memory and three gates
lstmspecial1.mechanism: 常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。~Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ.
lstmspecial1.verify: 在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。~Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes.
lstmspecial1.misconception: cell state與hidden state可在所有公式中互換。~Cell and hidden states are interchangeable in every equation.

lstmspecial2.title: 忘記閘與梯度路徑~Forget gates and gradient paths
lstmspecial2.mechanism: 簡化記憶路徑導數含忘記閘乘積；完整梯度還有其他相依路徑。~A simplified memory-path derivative contains products of forget gates; full gradients have other dependencies.
lstmspecial2.verify: 比較固定forget的簡式與有限差分完整小模型。~Compare fixed-forget simplification with full small-model finite differences.
lstmspecial2.misconception: 固定forget乘積就是完整LSTM總梯度。~A fixed-forget product is the full LSTM gradient.

lstmspecial3.title: 展開時間與共享權重~Unrolled time and shared weights
lstmspecial3.mechanism: 序列多步重用同組權重；展開步數增加啟動值需求但不直接倍增參數。~Timesteps reuse weights; unrolling increases activation storage without directly multiplying parameters.
lstmspecial3.verify: 比較10步及20步的參數數與保留狀態數。~Compare parameters/retained states for 10 and 20 steps.
lstmspecial3.misconception: 序列長度加倍就必然使LSTM參數加倍。~Doubling sequence length necessarily doubles LSTM parameters.

diffusionspecial1.title: 前向加噪與邊際~Forward noising and marginals
diffusionspecial1.mechanism: DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。~DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale.
diffusionspecial1.verify: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。~Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.
diffusionspecial1.misconception: 每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。~Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.

diffusionspecial2.title: 時間條件噪聲預測~Time-conditioned noise prediction
diffusionspecial2.mechanism: 去噪網路需知道噪聲等級；噪聲預測loss与生成分布品質不是同一指標。~Denoisers need noise-level conditions; noise-prediction loss differs from generated-distribution quality.
diffusionspecial2.verify: 比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。~Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions.
diffusionspecial2.misconception: 去掉時間條件不會影響任何去噪任務。~Removing time conditioning affects no denoising task.

diffusionspecial3.title: 反向取樣與可重現性~Reverse sampling and reproducibility
diffusionspecial3.mechanism: 反向生成是多步模型依赖過程；seed、排程與模型版本共同决定可重現邊界。~Reverse generation is a multistep model-dependent process; seeds, schedules and versions bound reproducibility.
diffusionspecial3.verify: 保存假想seed、時間序列與版本，分開比較單步誤差及最終品質。~Record assumed seeds, schedules and versions; separate single-step errors from final quality.
diffusionspecial3.misconception: 只保存prompt就足以重現所有擴散結果。~Saving only a prompt reproduces every diffusion result.

fortespecial1.title: 線性鏈與QCCD比較~Linear chains versus QCCD
fortespecial1.mechanism: Forte公開架構重點為光學可設定離子鏈；QCCD搬運是可比較的另一架構，不宣稱Forte實作跑道QCCD。~Forte emphasizes optically configurable ion chains; QCCD transport is a contrasting architecture, not a claim that Forte implements a racetrack QCCD.

scopes.ai: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。~Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.
scopes.servers: 公開伺服器與超算架構的離線工作流、通信、儲存及能量模型；非機櫃接線、供電施工或實體維護SOP，也不表示學員取得廠商／研究中心設備存取。~Offline workflow, fabric, storage and energy models of public servers/HPC. No rack-wiring, power-installation or physical-maintenance SOP and no vendor/research-center hardware access is implied.
scopes.energy: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。~Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
scopes.resources: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。~Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.

transfers.quantum: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。~Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
transfers.ai: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。~Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
transfers.servers: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。~Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
transfers.energy: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。~Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
transfers.resources: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。~Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
